top_0_1_private_wealth_share.note: Not yet directly extracted for this case. rev0338 keeps top-0.1 evidence missing but sourced to the measurement stack needed to close it.

public_social_counterweight.note: Public services exist but do not remove the private deposit/housing threshold.

lower_half_real_floor.note: Housing costs and liquidity limits keep floor unresolved.

early_foothold_open_access.note: Deposit, guarantee, and regional location access appear heavily family/tenure mediated.

group_person_closure.note: Requires ethnicity, disability, migration, region, household-form, age and tenure split.

housing_land_washout.note: Property wealth and rent/deposit pressure are central washout/entry channels.

pension_housing_age_hidden_wealth.note: Private pension and housing wealth can hide youth/renter entry failure.

ownership_legibility.note: Top-tail correction and property ownership structure need deeper extraction. rev0338 distinguishes ONS WAS quality limits, HMRC identified-wealth coverage, and top-tail distributional-accounting methods.

share_plausibility.why: Recorded household wealth is material but age/pension/housing composition blocks simple pass. Top-tail comfort now remains blocked against ONS quality limits, HMRC identified-wealth coverage limits, and distributional-accounting method debt.

floor_reality.why: Floor depends on housing, benefits, and liquidity, not just aggregate wealth.

threshold_moments.why: First deposit, guarantee, lease, and place thresholds remain closed for many young renters.

anti_averaging.why: Subgroup and tenure splits required before certification.

washout.why: Housing costs and entry prices can drain gains.
